studies.latest_known: Published July 2018 by DFID / International Centre for Evidence in Disability / Campbell Collaboration. This REA was a precursor to the full systematic review (Hunt et al. 2025), which covers the same question with a more rigorous methodology and a later search cut-off (March 2022). The Hunt et al. 2025 review functionally supersedes the 2018 REA in scope and rigour, and is itself the draft's primary source. No standalone update to the 2018 REA document found.
studies.what_changed: The 2018 REA has been superseded in scope and rigour by Hunt et al. 2025 (Campbell Systematic Reviews, e70016), which is a full systematic review with a March 2022 search cut-off covering the same question. However, because the draft draws no figures or claims from the 2018 REA — and in fact uses Hunt et al. 2025 as its primary source — this supersession does not introduce any error into the draft. The SUPERSEDED status is recorded for completeness and to flag that [4] should not be cited as current evidence in any future version of this document.
